lines.text: Many learners say: I wash hands before dinner.
Better: I wash my hands before dinner.
Her! She is brushing her hair.

data.right: I wash my hands before dinner.

native.tip: Нужно “my”: “I wash my hands before dinner.”
native.caption: Ты тоже говоришь “I wash hands before dinner”? 😅 По-русски говорят просто «мою руки», а в английском нужно сказать чьи: “my.” Правильно: “I wash my hands before dinner.” Послушай Аму и повтори! Больше практики — в приложении Lexkite.
native.comment: Ответ: “her.” С hair нужно her. Скажи вслух: “I wash my hands before dinner.” Бесплатный тест для практики здесь: {link}

en.tip: You need “my”: “I wash my hands before dinner.”
en.caption: Do you also say “I wash hands before dinner”? 😅 In Russian you just say wash hands, but English needs to say whose hands: “my.” Correct: “I wash my hands before dinner.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
